programme.title: Očima deteta
programme.desc: Emisija Očima deteta donosi zabavne igre, edukativne segmente i dečje perspektive na bitne i svakodnevne teme. Naše male zvezde istražuju svet kroz igru postavljajući pitanja na važne (i manje važne) životne dileme, dok su poznate ličnosti i stručnjaci iz različitih oblasti specijalni gosti u studiju Una televizije i pokušavaju i sami da se snađu dečjoj stolici.

programme.desc: Uspešni mladi advokat Radmilo već je godinama zaljubljen u lepu Beograđanku Ljiljanu. Uprkos tome što je najpoželjniji neženja svog malog grada, on odoleva svim primamljivim bračnim ponudama, i ostaje odlučan u nameri da baš Ljiljana bude njegova žena. Sa druge strane, Ljiljana sanjari o braku sa Momčilom koji u presudnom trenutku pokazuje svoje pravo lice i odbija da se oženi Ljiljanom, ismevajući je. Tako ona iz čistog prkosa pristaje da se uda za Radmila, i oni zajedno odlaze u Palanku, gde ih očekuju mnogi radoznali i sumnjičavi pogledi.

programme.title: Voda za slonove
programme.desc: U svetu surovog cirkusa, student veterine Džejkob i zvezda nastupa Marlena pronalaze zabranjenu ljubav kroz zajedničku brigu o slonu, uspevajući da pobegnu od njenog nasilnog muža i izgrade zajedničku budućnost.

programme.title: Kakodalogija
programme.desc: Emisija Kakodalogija, autora i voditelja Ivana Stankovića, otkriva šta se zaista krije iza velikih životnih i profesionalnih ostvarenja poznatih ličnosti i traži odgovor na pitanje – kako se postaje uspešan? Kroz jednosatne razgovore jedan na jedan sa ljudima koji su napravili značajne karijere i ostavili trag u svetu biznisa, kulture, sporta i javnog života, Ivan Stanković istražuje ono što često ostaje izvan poznatih biografija – neuspehe, pogrešne odluke, trenutke sumnje, strahove, prekretnice i izazove koji su oblikovali put njegovih sagovornika. Polazeći od jednostavnog pitanja kako da?, Kakodalogija istražuje kako prepoznati pravu priliku, doneti odluku kada nema dovoljno informacija, nastaviti nakon promašaja ili velikog pada i pronaći snagu za novi početak. Kroz konkretna iskustva gostiju, emisija otkriva koliko su na putu do cilja važni talenat i sreća, a koliko upornost, disciplina, hrabrost i spremnost na promene. Kakodalogija tako prevazilazi okvir klasičnog biografskog razgovora i postaje svojevrsni masterclass o životu, karijeri, ranjivosti i donošenju odluka, nudeći gledaocima ne samo inspiraciju, već i odgovore koji im mogu pomoći u njihovim ličnim kako da pitanjima.

programme.title: Una Dan
programme.desc: Una dan, centralna dnevna informativna emisija Una televizije, emituje se svakog dana u 18 časova i donosi najvažnije domaće i svetske vesti, precizno i pravovremeno. Kroz nepristrasno i prodorno novinarstvo, uz lokalni ugao posmatranja, Una dan gledaocima pruža jasan pregled dana. Vizuelne i grafičke inovacije, kao i primena virtuelne stvarnosti, doprinose modernom i dinamičnom doživljaju informativnog sadržaja.

programme.title: Štafeta
programme.desc: Štafeta je emisija Una televizije koja povezuje glasove ljudi iz svih država bivše Jugoslavije, otvarajući prostor za dijalog, razmenu mišljenja i suočavanje različitih pogleda na teme koje nas jednako dotiču. U vremenu kada nas svakodnevica često deli granicama, politikom i različitim interpretacijama prošlosti, Štafeta podseća da region i dalje deli iste emocije, dileme i iskustva. Svaka epizoda donosi jednu centralnu temu – od kulture, muzike i medija do identiteta, društvenih pitanja i života običnih ljudi. Kroz razgovore sa relevantnim sagovornicima iz Srbije, Hrvatske, Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Severne Makedonije i Slovenije, emisija gradi prostor u kojem svako ima pravo na svoj glas. Štafeta ne traži nužno zajednički odgovor, već iskren razgovor i pokušaj da se region ponovo čuje – bez buke, predrasuda i granica.

programme.title: Voleti do smrti
programme.desc: Voleti do smrti je priča o ljubavi, zločinu i osveti koja otkriva tajne života posle smrti. Ovo je priča o drugim prilikama, mogućnosti iskupljenja, mračnim putevima osvete, kao i o odnosu moći i ambicije. Leon Karvahal (Aleksis Ajala) jedan je od dvadeset najbogatijih poslovnih ljudi na svetu. Sa 60 godina odlučuje da se oženi Lusijom Borges (Anhelik Bojer), ženom koja je od njega mlađa tri decenije i izuzetne je lepote. Međutim, venčanje se pretvara u tragediju kada je, usred proslave, slavni milioner ubijen. U istom trenutku događaju se još dve smrti. U zatvoru u Teksasu, na električnoj stolici, pogubljen je opasni ubica poznat kao El Ćino Valdes (Mišel Braun), osuđen na smrtnu kaznu. Istovremeno, profesor Beltran Kamačo (Arturo Barba) gine nakon što njegov automobil sleti u provaliju. Iako se nikada nisu upoznali i njihovi životi nisu bili povezani, sva trojica umiru u istom trenutku, na različitim mestima i pod različitim okolnostima. Njihova smrt pokreće neverovatan niz reinkarnacija koje će zauvek promeniti živote mnogih ljudi.

programme.title: Zabranjena ljubav
programme.desc: Žade, mlada muslimanka odgajana po strogim pravilima tradicije u Maroku, zaljubljuje se u Brazilca Lukasa, mladića potpuno drugačijeg sveta i vrednosti. Njihova ljubav, snažna i iskrena, suočava se sa nepremostivim preprekama – verskim zakonima, porodičnim pritiscima i sudbinom koja ih razdvaja onda kada se najmanje nadaju. U isto vreme, naučnik dr Albieri, slomljen gubitkom bliske osobe, donosi kontroverznu odluku – da klonira čoveka. Tako nastaje Leo, mladić koji nosi Lucasov lik, ali ne i njegovu prošlost. Njegovo postojanje otvara pitanja identiteta, morala i granica nauke, dok se sudbine Jade, Lukasa i Lea ponovo prepliću. Zabranjena ljubav je emotivna i slojevita saga o strasti, sudaru tradicije i modernog sveta, o iskušenjima vere, ljubavi i nauke – i o tome da li je moguće pobediti sudbinu.

programme.title: Opasnost iz dubine
programme.desc: U jednom trenutku napada je velika bela ajkula i Nensi završava nasukana nedaleko od plaže. Međutim, iako je obala koja joj donosi spas udaljena tek dvesta metara, Nensi ne može tako lako da dođe do nje...

programme.title: Marsovac: Spasilačka misija
programme.desc: Napeta i inspirativna priča o astronautu Marku Vitniju (Met Dejmon) koji, nakon jake oluje, igrom slučaja ostaje sam i zaboravljen na Marsu, jer je posada mislila da je poginuo. Sa minimalnim zalihama hrane i vode, Mark koristi svoje znanje botaničara i inženjera da preživi na nemilosrdnoj planeti i pronađe način da pošalje signal Zemlji da je živ, dok NASA istovremeno ulaže sve napore da organizuje nemoguću misiju spasavanja.

programme.desc: Životinje čine nevjerojatne stvari, no kako one to rade? Stručnjaci otkrivaju tajne životinjskog carstva uz pomoć nevjerojatnih snimaka i iznenađujućih činjenica.

programme.title: Policajci za životinje Miami
programme.desc: Lovočuvare pozivaju da spase crnog medvjeda kojeg je udario auto. Za to vrijeme istražitelji se suočavaju s vlasnikom pogona za nezakonito klanje svinja.

programme.title: Policajci za životinje Miami
programme.desc: Tijekom spašavanja lamantinove peraje, otkriva se velika tajna. Za to vrijeme istražitelj Casadevall lovi krivolovce u čijem je napadu poginulo nekoliko životinja.

programme.title: Policajci za životinje Miami
programme.desc: Istražitelji su čvrsto odlučili zadovoljiti pravdu za napuštenu kuju i njezine štence, dok istražitelj Casadevall žuri pomoći psu koji ne može izdržati veliku vrućinu u Miamiju.

programme.title: Nevjerojatne životinje Dubaija
programme.desc: Iza modernog Dubaija skriva se pravo blago: nevjerojatan svijet divljih životinja koji govori o bezvremenskoj povezanosti s pustinjom, morem te povijesti i tradicijama svog naroda.

programme.title: Maleni divovi
programme.desc: Vrhunski fotoaparati snimaju mini čudovišta u svom prirodnom staništu kako bi vidjeli što su sve sposobni učiniti.

programme.title: Maleni divovi
programme.desc: Vrhunski fotoaparati snimaju mini čudovišta u svom prirodnom staništu kako bi vidjeli što su sve sposobni učiniti.

programme.title: Maleni divovi
programme.desc: Vrhunski fotoaparati snimaju mini čudovišta u svom prirodnom staništu kako bi vidjeli što su sve sposobni učiniti.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Veterinarska bolnica "Rocky Mountain"
programme.desc: Dr. Amy nalazi se pred izazovom kad debeloj mački Chubbs mora hitno izvesti kirurški zahvat na licu, a njezin tim poslije liječi labradora čija su leđa prepuna sačme.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Veterinarska bolnica "Rocky Mountain"
programme.desc: Kada 5-mjesečni štenac jednog beskućnika slomi šapicu, dr. Jeff i njegov tim na prvo mjesto stavljaju dobrobit životinje. Poslije im donose psa kojeg boli.

programme.title: Neimenovani projekt obitelji Irwin
programme.desc: Robert nastavlja očevim stopama u svom radu s agresivnim krokodilom Boscom, dok Bindi liječi koalu oboljelu od klamidije.

programme.title: Neimenovani projekt obitelji Irwin
programme.desc: Obitelj se vraća u Utočište za divlje životinje Steve Irwin kako bi proučavali krokodile. Bindi i Chandler imaju uzbudljivu objavu koja će sve promijeniti!

programme.title: Jeremy Wade: Mračne vode
programme.desc: Ribolovac i pustolov Jeremy Wade putuje na Aljasku da bi otkrio što se dogodilo s kraljevskim lososima - snažnim sportašima u svijetu lososa.

programme.title: Pitbuli i kažnjenici
programme.desc: Čut ćemo priče o onome što se događalo iza kulisa i prisjetiti se jedinstvenih pasa koji su imali veliki utjecaj na Tijinu obitelj i na kažnjenike koji su im pomogli.

programme.title: Moja mačka iz pakla
programme.desc: Alan i Shannon željeli su mačku s kojom bi se mazili, a umjesto nje dobili su Barnabasa, mačka koji stalno frkće i grebe. Jedino što ga može smiriti je operna glazba.

programme.title: Luđački bazeni: Poludimo do kraja
programme.desc: Lucas Congdon mora izraditi vanjsku vodenu prostoriju u kojoj bi mogla živjeti sirena. Bivši klijenti, koji vole sve u vezi s morem, mole Lucasa da preuredi njihov sićušni bazen.

programme.title: Luđački bazeni: Poludimo do kraja
programme.desc: Lucas, genijalac za bazene, pretvara zapušteno dvorište u čudesni vodeni park. Ovo je njegov dosad najveći pothvat u kojem je izradio i prostor za obiteljsku zabavu.

programme.title: Izumrli ili živi
programme.desc: Biolog Forrest Gallante pretražuje Zemlju služeći se vrhunskom tehnologijom kako bi pronašao vrste koje je svijet prestao tražiti.

programme.title: Kraljevi akvarija
programme.desc: Superzvijezda NBA-a, Anthony Davis, želi da mu Wayde i Brett cijelu sobu pretvore u akvarij! Hoće li dečki uspjeti izgraditi pobjednički akvarij?

programme.title: Kraljevi akvarija
programme.desc: Komičar Bill Engvall želi Zen akvarij za svoj novi ured u Hollywoodu. No stroga ograničenje težine mogu mu poremetiti planove.

programme.title: Kraljevi akvarija
programme.desc: Zvijezda NBA lige John Wall želi da mu tvrtka ATM izgradi akvarij u obliku golemog para kocki. U Georgiji ekipa gradi golemi akvarij u obliku svjetionika za mjesni riblji restoran.

programme.title: Posljednji stanovnici Aljaske
programme.desc: Pada mrak, a Heimo je u divljini, kilometrima daleko od doma. Obitelj Lewis priprema se za događaj koji će im promijeniti život.

programme.title: Zoološki vrt
programme.desc: Pogled na svakodnevni život u zoološkom vrtu u Bronxu i sve što je potrebno da bi se životinjama pružila kvalitetna skrb dok se javnost obrazuje o životinjama i očuvanju prirode.

programme.title: Imanje za spašavanje
programme.desc: Obitelji koje se sele daleko od civilizacije moraju mnogo naučiti. U posljednjem pokušaju da spase svoja imanja pozivaju stručnjake za preživljavanje da ih pripreme na najgore.

programme.title: Čovjek za velike ribe
programme.desc: Jakub Vagner putuje prostranim divljinama Mongolije u potrazi za predivnom ribom koju su tek rijetki ikad i vidjeli, a kamoli uhvatili - golemim sibirskim lososom.

programme.title: Životinjski domovi
programme.desc: Par od Antonija traži da dizajnira savršen vanjski prostor za njihovu mačku vrste savannah i udomljene mačiće. On gradi povezane šetnice i složene površine za penjanje.

programme.title: Teksaški zakon
programme.desc: Žestoko nevrijeme pogađa Teksas i Eddins žuri do srušenog dalekovoda čije su žice još pod naponom. Usto, Richard pokušava uručiti nalog za uhićenje.

programme.title: Ljudi iz aljaške divljine
programme.desc: Duboko u aljaškom bušu živi obitelj rođena i odgojena u divljini. Billy i Amy Brown i njihovo sedmero djece žive sasvim izolirano i oslanjaju se jedni na druge da bi preživjeli.

programme.title: Ljudi iz aljaške divljine

programme.desc: Obitelj Irwin, Terry, Bindi i Robert, odaju počast ostavštini borca za zaštitu prirode, Stevea Irwina, putem svog rada u golemom australskom zoološkom vrtu.

Land Of the Blind
programme.desc: A soldier recounts his relationship with a famous political prisoner attempting to overthrow their country's authoritarian government.

programme.title: Digging Into China
programme.desc: Harriet, a ten-year old girl, lives together with her big sister and her alcoholic mother out in the countryside. The family runs a motel. Harriet is different from the others, as she owns a great creativity and has nobody to play with. Her infinite world exists only in her mind. One day, Ricky comes along. He is a grown-up, but retarded son of an elderly lady. Soon, Harriet and Ricky share their experiences of life from a different point of view and become close friends. But his mother still plans to give Ricky away into professional care in a home, because she won't live forever to be there for him.

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: Bob and Amy are at a crossroads: she wants to adopt a child, he doesn't. Will renovating their house and rescuing animals solve their problems? Will their new handyman and his son's pregnant girlfriend be the miracle they're looking for?...

programme.title: Riff Raff
programme.desc: Vincent is an ex-criminal who more than anything, just wants a normal, peaceful life. He and his wife Sandy, have built a loving family with their son DJ and are spending their last summer in a cabin before he goes off to college. Chaos ensues when Vincent's disowned son Rocco, his girlfriend Marina, and Vincent's ex-wife Ruth abruptly show up to spoil the festivities with an ominous warning: famed gangsters Leftie and Lonnie are coming for them.

programme.title: Spirit
programme.desc: A recently bereved father takes his daughter to a new town only to find that their new Victorian house appears to be haunted.

programme.title: Wake of Death
programme.desc: Ben Archer, an ex-mob enforcer, seeks revenge against a ruthless Chinese kingpin responsible for his wife's brutal murder. When Archer joins forces with his old underworld friends, an all-out war is waged against the Chinese Triad.

programme.title: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Two cop partners, who are also best friends attend a domestic disturbance, only for one to accidentaly critically wound the other. The rest of the police force are suspicious that there may have been no accident.

programme.title: Malpractice
programme.desc: Here is a surgeon. He can't practice medicine anymore because he has panic attacks, while reliving a surgery gone bad. His wife is a medical malpractice attorney who picks up a case from a woman who was her husband's nurse.

programme.title: Daydream Believers: The Monkees' Story
programme.desc: In 1966, producers Bert Schneider and Bob Rafaelson come up with the idea of creating a TV show that would feature the American answer to the Beatles, The Monkees. Eventually, four young men are chosen for the roles, Mickey Dolenz the former child TV star, the stage actor Davey Jones and the musicians, Mike Nesmith and Peter Tork. With the aid of a successful music producer and able TV promotion, the Monkees become a sensation. However, that success is tainted, to the chagrin of the band, as they find themselves labeled as talentless phonies. This film covers the band's frustrating struggle to prove their detractors wrong as they struggle to earn some artist legitimacy. Whether it's by learning to excel as a band or experimenting with wild ideas for their show and film, Head, nothing seems to work. Meanwhile the band have their internal tensions as various members struggle to decide what is really important to them...

programme.title: The Howling: Reborn
programme.desc: In the sequel to The Howling. On the eve of his high school graduation, unremarkable Will Kidman finally bonds with the girl he has long yearned for, reclusive Eliana Wynter. But he also discovers a dark secret from his past... that he is about to become a werewolf. 1 Jul 13, in an effort to fight destiny and save their love as well as their lives, they must battle not only Will's growing blood lust but an army of fearsome beasts bent on killing them... and then, us all.

programme.title: Redemption of the Ghost
programme.desc: Convicted embezzler Witt Hampton escapes from prison and while hiding out in an isolated country barn is discovered by young Cassy and her brother Jack. After convincing them he's a friendly ghost that only they can see, the three new friends embark on one imaginative adventure after another until, inspired by their innocent spirits, Witt vows to redeem his crimes. But, a by-the-book sheriff-who has sworn to personally put Hampton back behind bars-is closing in, and Witt may never get the chance to finally set things right.

programme.title: Lost on a Mountain in Maine
Running for Grace
programme.desc: A timeless story set in Hawaii in 1920s, about a young man who transcends the boundaries of race and class in search of forbidden love.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: Sharon Maguire's Oscar-nominated romantic comedy, starring Renee Zellweger, Colin Firth and Hugh Grant. As a New Year's Resolution, a British woman seeks to improve her mundane life and decides to go in search of her perfect companion before having a fling with her boss, keeping a diary of her actions along the way. Celia Imrie is among the co-stars.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: Beeban Kidron's romantic comedy sequel, with Renee Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Colin Firth. Bridget is questioning her romance with Mark Darcy when her sneaky boss Daniel returns, and the possibility of an exotic holiday gives her a chance to run away from it all.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Romantic comedy revolving around complicated love life of Bridget Jones. Bridget is 43 and her mom keeps on reminding her that her time to have a child is running out. She goes to attend the funeral of Daniel Cleaver, and there sees her ex, Mark Darcy and his new wife Camilla. At a music festival she has a one-night stand with a very handsome man Jack. At the christening of Jude's youngest child, she meets Mark again and finds out he is divorcing. They realize they are still in love, and spend the night together. A few weeks later, Bridget finds out she is pregnant, and is unsure if Darcy or Jack is the father.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
Pirates of Somalia
programme.desc: In 2008, rookie journalist Jay Bahadur forms a half-baked plan to embed himself among the pirates of Somalia. He ultimately succeeds in providing the first close-up look into who these men are, how they live, and the forces that drive them.

programme.title: Alex of Venice
programme.desc: A workaholic attorney is forced to reinvent her life after her husband suddenly leaves.

programme.title: Obožavam te!
programme.desc: Grej Evans i Mia Lang su mladi glumački par čiji brak je dinamičan čak i nakon godinu dana. Glamurozne premijere i opijanja na VIP žurkama, gde mogu da se druže s Elvisom Kostelom, čitanje pošte obožavalaca i sve ono što im garantuje simpatije i naklonost publike. Ali prava slika Grejove narcisoidnosti jeste njegovo verovanje da ga neko uhodi. To možda jeste, možda i nije istina, ali njegova fiksacija je tolika da ne samo da zamišlja sopstvenu smrt, već počinje i sam da uhodi radnika video kluba, koga smatra srećnijim od sebe. Grej ujedno fantazira o običnom životu s bivšom devojkom.

programme.title: Igra u četvoro
programme.desc: Kerol (Alis Taljoni), ilustratorka knjiga za decu, ugovara pregled kod ginekologa. Pokazuje se da je ginekolog poznanik Lajonel (Fransoa Kluzet). Kerol i Lajonel tokom tog pregleda slučajno otkrivaju da njihove partnere veže ljubavnički odnos. Oboje žele da spasu svoje veze. Zato se dogovaraju da će učiniti sve kako bi povratili svoje partnere. Kako bi ostvarili cilj koriste se različitim metodima i načinima, često smešnim. Uskoro nešto dublje počinje povezivati Kerol i Lajonela. Osveta je slatka.

programme.title: Dolina borbi
programme.desc: Mlada žena pronađena je mrtva nakon uplitanja u nezakonite borbe. Njena sestra, Vindzor, počinje da trenira s poznatim bivšim borcem, u nameri da tako pronađe ubicu.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Olimpijski snovi
programme.desc: U Olimpijskom selu sportista mlada skijašica se zbližava sa volonterom dok se završava njen takmičarski nastup.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Vampirice
programme.desc: Dve vampirice u današnjem Njujorku suočavaju se sa zastrašujućim ljubavnim mogućnostima.

programme.title: Satin
programme.desc: Propali pevač iz Las Vegasa, Džek Satin, nema novca, nema posao i u zabludi je da će se proslaviti. Kada je primoran da napusti Vegas, seda u svoj stari kadilak i odlazi u Atlantik Siti. Tamo upoznaje Loren, vlasnicu lokalnog bara koja mu pomaže da shvati da je život mnogo više od puke jurnjave za slavom i bogatstva.

programme.title: Kralj boraca
programme.desc: Film akcije na osnovi priče iz video igre "Kralj ratnika".

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Tinejdžerka tajni agent
programme.desc: Žestoki, snalažljivi privatni detektiv, pristaje da u okviru istrage FBI bude deo tajnog zadatka unutar bratstva na koledžu.

programme.title: Disko
programme.desc: Didje je četrdesetogodišnjak _ fan disko muzike. Muškarac nema posla i još uvek živi sa majkom. Didje ima sina, kojeg dugo nije video, ipak njegova majka ne slaže se da zajedno provedu odmor. Didje odlučuje da pobedi u plesnom konkursu, da dobije nagradu i da povede sina na nezaboravni odmor u Australiju. Muškarac nagovara svoje prijatelje da mu pomognu. Zapošljavaju trenera, koji treba da ih pripremi za takmičenje. Brzo se uspostavlja, da makar nekad bili su odlični plesači, vreme je uradilo svoje. Moraju puno da rade da bi nastupili.

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Ubojita magija
programme.desc: Na turneji po Britaniji 1926. godine, Hari Hudini započinje strastvenu vezu sa vidovnjakinjom koja namerava da prevari sjajnog mađioničara.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: So Do-jong naređuje Dong-suu da osnuje novu advokatsku kancelariju nakon propasti prethodne.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Nakon promena u rukovodstvu, Do-jong preuzima vlast, a posledice ranijih postupaka menjaju živote svih umešanih.

programme.title: Ona je kriminalac
programme.desc: Sju Parker gurnuta je u očajničku borbu da spase porodični posao koji se, zbog nemara njenog oca, nalazi na ivici propasti. Dolaskom šarmantnog skitnice, ona prepoznaje jedinu nadu da spreči da njihov bar padne u ruke nemilosrdnog lokalnog tajkuna.

programme.title: Barska svađa!
programme.desc: Nina i Alen nakon raskida dele sve što su zajedno stekli u životu, ali ih očekuje urnebesna borba za vlasništvo nad njihovim dragocenim pabom. U ovoj borbi povlači se crta, bira se strana i počinje ludo takmičenje u ispijanju piva.

programme.title: Barska svađa!
programme.desc: Nina i Alen nakon raskida dele sve što su zajedno stekli u životu, ali ih očekuje urnebesna borba za vlasništvo nad njihovim dragocenim pabom. U ovoj borbi povlači se crta, bira se strana i počinje ludo takmičenje u ispijanju piva.

programme.title: Pravda za sve
programme.desc: Kada Sietl opsednu nasilni i bezobzirni dileri heroinom, Elija Kejn pokreće elitnu policijsku jedinici da ih privedu pravdi. Kejn i njegov tim zanemaruju pravila službe i služe se svim i brutalnim metodama u nameri da sa gradskih ulica sklone trgovce droge.

programme.title: Pravda za sve
programme.desc: Ilajža Kejn, bivši operativac specijalne jedinice i ekspert za borilačke veštine, deo je policijskog tima za tajne zadatke koji često na brutalan način sprovodi zakon na ulici.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Čovek od poverenja
programme.desc: Priča o Beriju Monkovu, mladom harizmatičnom biznismenu koji postaje imućni direktor i stiže do samog vrha uz pomoć laži, prevara i krađe.

programme.title: Loša genetika
programme.desc: Žena koja je ostavljena jedanaest puta, otkriva (na svoje zaprepašćenje) da ima gubitničke ljubavne gene.

programme.title: Istina o lažima
programme.desc: Gilbi se zatiče u zamršenoj mreži laži, jer je istinu preteško priznati, a još teže prihvatiti.

programme.title: Vellčanstveni Ambersonovi
programme.desc: Razmaženo derište, Džordž Amberson, užasnut je kada njegova majka, odnedavno udovica, obnovi vezu s imućnim Judžinom Morganom, koga je ostavila nekoliko decenija ranije, kako bi se udala za Džordžovog oca. Dok se Džordž trudi da sabotira romansu svoje majke, mora se nositi i sa sopstvenim osećanjima prema Morganovoj ćerci.

programme.title: Mrvica i rudnik zlata
programme.desc: Nakon ponovnog ujedinjenja s porodicom, Mrvica se teško navikava na luksuzan život. Kada ga otme stari neprijatelj, mora upotrebiti najbolje stečeno znanje iz novog i starog života, kako bi pobegao i spasao svoje roditelje.

programme.title: Uhvati me za ruku
programme.desc: Majka troje dece, koja živi u Londonu i nalazi se na vrhuncu karijere, saznaje da boluje od multiple skleroze. Nakon iznenadne smrti supruga i gubitka posla, vraća se u rodnu Australiju, gde slučajan susret sa srednjoškolskom ljubavi budi novu nadu u ljubav dok vodi tešku borbu sa bolešću.

programme.title: Gorko-slatko
programme.desc: Ekscentrični i bogati trgovac kafom, šalje priznatog stručnjaka u Tajland, gde treba da otkupi novu, egzotičnu vrstu kafe. Njegov "savršen" život ispada iz koloseka kad se, nakon prvobitne netrpeljivosti, zaljubljuje u prelepu ćerku vlasnika plantaže, a onda otkriva da ga šef ustvari uopšte nije poslao zbog kupovine kafe.

programme.title: Poslednja potera
programme.desc: Godine 1909, Vili Boj i njegova voljena Karlota beže nakon što on u kobnom sukobu slučajno usmrti njenog oca. Dok se predsednik Taft sprema da poseti ovu oblast, lokalni šerif i dvojica indijanskih tragača kreću u poteru za čovekom kog smatraju ubicom svog plemenskog vođe.

programme.title: Draga Elizabet
programme.desc: Muškarac koji vodi dosadan život slučajno počinje da proganja staru koleginicu s fakulteta, glumicu Elizabet Benks, na društvenim mrežama. U svojim pokušajima da dokaže da je poznaje, ponovo otkriva sebe i pravo značenje prijateljstva.

programme.title: Pustinjski plen
programme.desc: Mlada botaničarka dolazi u mali pustinjski grad kako bi proučavala invazivnu biljnu vrstu. Nakon pada aviona, zarobljava je neiskusni kurir droge i primorava da ga vodi kroz surovu pustinju. Dok šerif traga za njima, njegova buntovna ćerka kreće u potragu za nestalom naučnicom.

programme.title: Život u strahu
programme.desc: Muž i žena vraćaju se u njegov rodni grad, na otvaranje očevog testamenta. Ubrzo im postaje jasno da je grad krcat Čakovim davnašnjim neprijateljima. Mnogi od njih smatraju da ih je njegov otac (sveštenik) prevario za investicije vredne 250 hiljada dolara.

programme.title: Cigarete na komad
programme.desc: Bobi, njujorški džeparoš koji se svuda predstavlja kao broker, izaziva sudbinu kada krade značku njujorškog detektiva, na nezadovoljstvo svog izuzetno manipulativnog dilera ukradenim stvarima. Igrajući ovu opasnu igru mačke i miša, Bobi nailazi na još veći izazov: vezu za jednu noć, s devojkom po imenu Lusi. Tri meseca nakon strastvene zajedničke noći, Lusi mu saopštava da je trudna. Iznenada, dva potpuno različita sveta se sudaraju, što Bobiju nalaže da preispita dotadašnji život. U gradu za koji je nekad bio nevidljiv, Bobi je sada prilično poznat i tražen.

programme.title: Australijski gangster
programme.desc: Paskal Barbaro (Aleksandar Bertran) izlazi iz zatvora, ali tek kada razvije neprijateljstvo s članom grupe "Braća zauvek", Malim Ludakom (Rahel Roman). Les Elijas (Salvatore Koko) predlaže Barbaru da se poveže s Farhadom "Avganistanskim guruom" (Majkl Vajs), novim vođom grupe "Braća zauvek", koji mrzi Malog Ludaka, i da njihov sukob pretvori u sopstvenu korist.

programme.title: Devojka broj jedan
programme.desc: Producent, režiser i akciona zvezda; to je sve što vam je potrebno da snimite najbolji film svih vremena. Zar ne?

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Deset stvari koje bi trebalo da uradimo pre raskida
programme.desc: Kada Ebigejl, samohrana majka dvoje dece, zatrudni nakon jedne noći provedene s Benom, ovaj neobični par pokušaće da se izbori s novonastalom situacijom.

programme.title: Smrtonosni medeni mesec
programme.desc: Par se venčava na Havajima i za medeni mesec polaze na krstarenje, ali stvari kreću užasno loše

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Ljubav na prvi lajk
programme.desc: Cinična novinarka dobija zadatak da piše o zavodniku sa dejting aplikacija, ali ubrzo otkriva da se iza njegove reputacije krije mnogo više od onoga što je očekivala.

programme.title: Olimpijski snovi
programme.desc: U Olimpijskom selu sportista mlada skijašica se zbližava sa volonterom dok se završava njen takmičarski nastup.

programme.title: Uzmi novac i beži
programme.desc: Ljubav, luksuz i bogatstvo učvršćuju Rujin položaj na vrhu. Dok OneCoin osvaja svet, ona postaje međunarodna zvezda. Međutim, kako raste njena moć, umnožavaju se i neprijatelji. Optužbe za prevaru, izdaje iz najbližeg okruženja i sve veći pritisak prete da sruše carstvo koje je godinama pažljivo gradila.

programme.title: Uzmi novac i beži
programme.desc: OneCoin odavno nije samo kriptovaluta, već pokret čiji je neprikosnoveni vođa Ruja Ignatova. Uverena u sopstvenu nepogrešivost, pokušava da zaključi ambiciozan posao sa uticajnim biznismenom Li Čanom u Hongkongu. Međutim, upravo će taj potez pokrenuti događaje koji će ugroziti sve što je izgradila.

programme.title: Vampirice
programme.desc: Dve vampirice u današnjem Njujorku suočavaju se sa zastrašujućim ljubavnim mogućnostima.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Šta sve radimo za ljubav
programme.desc: Ambiciozna Sofi napušta mali posrednički biro i prelazi u prestižnu firmu Floating Lotus na Menhetnu. Kao pomoćni posrednik brzo ulazi u sukob sa harizmatičnim Džejsonom Šarpom, sinom vlasnika i kompanijinim lajf koučem. Ipak, njih dvoje primorani su da rade zajedno.

programme.title: Šta učini, sine moj?
programme.desc: Inspirisan zločinom koji se dogodio, čovek počinje da doživljava stvari koje će ga navesti da mačem ubije rođenu majku.

programme.title: Sivi čovek
programme.desc: Ozloglašeni serijski ubica, Albert Fiš, majstor prijatne spoljašnosti, prikazan je u realističnom Njujorku dvadesetih godina prošlog veka, gde pronalazi lakoverne mlade žrtve i pothranjuje sopstvenu izopačenost. Perspektivnom detektivu dodeljen je slučaj nedavno nestalog deteta, dvanaestogodišnje Grejs Bad.

programme.title: Crni policajac
programme.desc: Crni policajac gurnut je preko ivice, a svoje frustracije istrešće na privilegovanoj zajednici koju se zakleo da će štititi.

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Paris
programme.desc: Love, marriage and heartache in paris after the war.

programme.title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
programme.desc: Ruthless woman has her dark past of a concealed murder return.

programme.title: Guerrero
programme.desc: In the depths of the Sierra of Guerrero in Mexico, after the disappearance of the 43 students, we find the reaction of wounded civil society to seek an answer to the situation of abuse of authority mixed with poverty.

programme.title: Cyrano de Bergerac
programme.desc: Swordsman-poet helps soldier woo the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Trial
programme.desc: Josef K wakes up in the morning and finds the police in his room. They tell him that he is on trial but nobody tells him what he is accused of. In order to find out about the reason for this accusation and to protest his innocence, he tries to look behind the façade of the judicial system. But since this remains fruitless, there seems to be no chance for him to escape from this nightmare.

programme.title: Life with Father
programme.desc: A financier from New York rules his numerous family, consisting of his wife and his four sons, with the meticulousness of a bookkeeper.

programme.title: Behave Yourself
programme.desc: When a cute Welsh terrier follows Bill Denny home, little does he know that all gangland has its eye on that dog.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: Ageing, wealthy, rancher and self-made man, George Washington McLintock is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife—who left him two years previously—suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in George; she wants custody of their daughter.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: A Confederate veteran living in the Yankee North struggles with his son's shock induced muteness and the hate of the Northerners.

programme.title: Sixty Glorious Years
programme.desc: Picking up where Victoria the Great (1937) left off, this sequel to the 1937 film has Anna Neagle return to the role of Queen Victoria in another colorful account of the revered British monarch's reign.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: When an only child is struck by a car and dies, the child's mother seeks vengeance against the driver in this thrilling drama. The car was driven by the wife of a company president who is having an affair. The woman's husband manages to buy silence about the incident, but the victim's mother discovers the identity of the driver. After she secures a job in the home of the company president and his philandering spouse, the woman plans to murder the couple's son when he reaches the age of her late son.

programme.title: A Farewell to Arms
programme.desc: A ravishing adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's legendary novel, A FAREWELL TO ARMS stars Gary Cooper as Lt. Frederic Henry, a young ambulance driver for the Italian army in WWI, more interested in chasing women than the enemy. When seeking cover during an air raid, he encounters Nurse Catherine Barkley, and the world shifts under his feet. They fall in love, but the war keeps wrenching them apart. These painful separations force Frederic to choose between love and battle, a decision that tests him morally and spiritually, and leads to one of the most rapturously romantic endings of all time.

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: True smile is the story about a trip through the empty glance of an autist and blind boy who crosses 1.300 kms in tandem bycicle with his brother. This documentary inmerses us into the Sergio's unreachable world, that seems to the desert, the destination of their trip.

programme.title: Night Light
programme.desc: A 14-year-old boy is about to go and live with his mother in the city. Before leaving his hometown, he has to confront his father's inability to give him an integrated family.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: Secret Service agents make a deal with a counterfeiting inmate to be released on early parole if he will help them recover some bogus moneymaking plates, but he plans to double cross them.

programme.title: Carnival of Souls
programme.desc: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past.

programme.title: Carnival of Souls

programme.title: The Pilgrim
programme.desc: Disguised as a priest, an escaped convict makes his way to Texas. He ends up in a small rural town where the townsfolk mistake him for their new church minister.

programme.title: Gregoire
programme.desc: Loosely based on real life events, Gregoire follows four young adults and the choices they make when put at a crossroads of their life. As they struggle to make choices, their paths cross with one another and their choices affect not only themselves, but their friends, and their families.

programme.title: The Strange Woman
programme.desc: In early 19th century New England, an attractive unscrupulous woman uses her beauty and wits to deceive and control the men around her.

programme.title: Mother
programme.desc: A teenaged girl witnesses her widowed mother's attempt to sustain her family.

programme.title: Joan of Arkansas
programme.desc: When the U.S. Space program requires an ordinary person to become the first human in space, the Saraback Computer chooses Joan Jones, a scatter brained, good natured klutz who works as a dental technician.

programme.title: Impact
programme.desc: A unfaithful wife plots with her lover to kill her husband, but the lover is accidentally killed instead. The husband stays in hiding and lets his wife be charged with conspiracy.

programme.title: Little Lord Fauntleroy
programme.desc: An American boy turns out to be the long-lost heir of a British fortune. He is sent to live with the cold and unsentimental lord who oversees the trust.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: Notorious shootist and womanizer Quirt Evans' horse collapses as he passes a Quaker family's home. Quirt has been wounded, and the kindly family takes him in to nurse him back to health against the advice of others.

programme.title: Answer Me
programme.desc: The love story of a couple which, after the marriage and the birth of the first son, turns into hell. Taken from the novel Rispondimi by Susanna Tamaro.

programme.title: Sunny
programme.desc: The beautiful Anna Neagle stars as a circus performer who falls in love with a rich car dealer's son, against her family's wishes. Features some spirited dance numbers with Ray Bolger.

programme.title: Father
programme.desc: Mourning the death of her father, Giulia is contacted by him from the other dimension.

programme.title: And Then There Were None
programme.desc: Seven guests, a newly hired personal secretary and two staff are gathered for a weekend on an isolated island by the hosts the Owens who are delayed. At dinner a record is played and the host's message alleges that all the people present are guilty of murder and suddenly the first of them is dead, then the next _ It seems that one of them is the murderer but the leading person is always the person who is murdered next and at last only two people are left.

programme.title: Roaring Abyss
programme.desc: A sound journey accros the mountains, deserts and forests of Ethiopia and its cultural universe. Roaring Abyss will take you through an inedit collection of music recordings of unvaluable importance for the transmission and preservation of the African heritage.

programme.title: Quality Time
programme.desc: Five thirty-something men in as many separate segments struggle to grapple with the relentless absurdity of their respective existences.

programme.title: Frieda
programme.desc: A Royal Air Force pilot who was shot down during World War II returns home to his English village with his new bride. The trouble is that she is the German lady who helped him escape. Then her brother arrives.

programme.title: Footprints on the Moon
programme.desc: A woman is tormented by strange dreams of astronauts on the moon. She visits a deserted seaside town whose inhabitants know her although she does not know them.

programme.title: Footprints on the Moon
programme.desc: A woman is tormented by strange dreams of astronauts on the moon. She visits a deserted seaside town whose inhabitants know her although she does not know them.

programme.title: Lady of Burlesque
programme.desc: After one member of their group is murdered, the performers at a burlesque house must work together to find out who the killer is before they strike again.

programme.title: Went the Day Well?
programme.desc: The quiet village of Bramley End is taken over by German troops posing as Royal Engineers. Their task is to disrupt England's radar network in preparation for a full scale German invasion. Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.

programme.title: Quelqu'un derricre la porte
programme.desc: A neurosurgeon with a cheating wife takes an amnesiac into his home and conditions him to believe that the cheating wife is his own and to take the "appropriate" action.

programme.title: The Lady of Musashino
programme.desc: Set in post-war Japan, The Lady of Musashino tells the story of Michiko, a disillusioned young woman trapped in a loveless marriage. She confides in her younger cousin, Tsutomo, and the two become close, but decide not to consummate their affair. He instead becomes involved with the flirtatious Tomiko, who is also conducting an affair with Michiko's husband. When Michiko finds that her husband has abandoned her, she decides to take her fate into her own hands.

programme.title: Daughters, Wives and a Mother
programme.desc: Tashiro coincidentally meets his best friend Sugimoto in a bar very close to the apartment in which Sugimoto's wayward wife is found dead. Although Tashiro is not a suspect in the police investigation, he is racked with guilt and confesses to his wife, Masako. In an effort to further relieve his tortured sense of guilt, he then confesses to Sugimoto. Neither his wife nor his friend can believe that he could have been involved.

programme.title: Smash-up, the Story of a Woman
programme.desc: A successful nightclub singer weds a struggling songwriter, but when his fame eclipses hers, she delves into alcoholism.

programme.title: People We Know Are Confused
programme.desc: Set in Vilnius, a modern city still in search for its relation to the past, three parallel stories with three average people marooned in a state of change, looking to the future with hope, but not letting go of constricting and reassuring fears of their past.

programme.title: Beneath the 12-Mile Reef
programme.desc: Fierce competition among sponge fishermen forces a Greek-American family to fish in the dangerous 12-mile reef area off the western coast of Florida.

programme.title: Too Late for Tears
programme.desc: Through a fluke circumstance, a ruthless woman stumbles across a suitcase filled with $60,000, and is determined to hold onto it even if it means murder.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: Due to a possible cholera epidemic onboard, passengers on a ship are forced to disembark at Pago Pago, a small village on a Pacific island where it incessantly rains. Among the stranded passengers are Sadie Thompson, a prostitute, and Alfred Davidson, a fanatic missionary who will try to redeem her.

programme.title: Go for Broke!
programme.desc: The story of Japanese-American soldiers who fought in Europe during World War II.

programme.title: Indiscreet
programme.desc: A young woman jeopardizes the relationship with the man she loves when a no-account from her past shows up.

programme.title: Sea Dragon
programme.desc: A young fossil hunter makes a groundbreaking discovery, challenging the worldview of 19th century England.

programme.title: They Made Me a Criminal
programme.desc: A champion boxer on the lamb, believed to have committed murder while drunk, takes refuge and finds redemption at a farm for delinquent youths.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Masters of stealth or speed, using enhanced senses and lethal strategies to hunt, Africa's killers include the incredibly fast cheetah and lions, which while slower, have raw power and ingenious teamwork on their side. The rivers, meanwhile, hold fearsome crocodiles.

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: Across Africa, predators use the land to amplify their hunting skills. In Ndutu, cheetahs rely on speed and lookout points, even using fawns as bait. Lions, heavier and slower, depend on cover—gullies, marshes, forests—for ambushes. As the wildebeest migration arrives, we follow three characters through the rainy season, watching calves grow and predators adapt. The film explores how these hunters use the landscape, passing knowledge from one generation to the next.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: There's more than just one creature lurking in this black lagoon. Here, in this bizarre netherworld between river and ocean, evolution has created a variety of freakish assassins, many of whom can strike in the blink of an eye. Witness the fast-paced, deadly action up close and in slow motion as our high-speed cameras capture sharp-shooting archerfish, African fish eagles, mantis shrimp, and other killers at work. Cutting-edge CGI details show just how they use their alien jaws, spear-like arms, and color-changing skin as weapons of underwater war.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Since the 1970's, sea lion populations have declined more than 80% along the North Pacific coast. Scientists at the University of British Columbia and the Vancouver Aquarium are working together to help save Canada's iconic and largest pinniped _ the stellar sea lion To help understand why their numbers are dropping, researchers work with the highly intelligent mammals at a unique floating laboratory. At The Open Water Research Station, free swimming seals and sea lions are observed in their natural habitat.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Posse the red panda and Santiago the saki have been having issues with their teeth. The dentist has arrived but he's got some good news and bad news. The good news is neither of them have to foot the bill. The bad news is, he's brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process? Loro Parque reports from the Bolivian front line and the front row of the local fashion parade!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We travel to the end of the rainbow in Dublin, Ireland. We'll gawk at the Book of Kells, a holy book displayed at Trinity College. We visited the hallowed halls of St. Patrick's Cathedral, and touched famed Irishman, Daniel O'Connell's crypt at Glasnevin Cemetery. Finally, we learn the complicated history of Irish independence at Kilmainham jail.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Get your sun tan lotion on, because we're headed to the land of perfect weather and sunsets. We'll sample a fish taco, climb the 100's of steps of the California Tower, stand on the flight deck of the USS Midway, as well as, revisit San Diego's founding on the San Salvador at the San Diego Maritime museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Running the Portland Canal from Prince Rupert to Alaska...and fishing Alaskan Halibut!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy's ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia's wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Join us as we explore the Gateway to India—Mumbai. From its early history, it's many foreign occupations to the hustle and bustle of today. Bill tells Mumbai's rich history is told through two of its most famous inhabitants, Gandhi and Kipling. We delve into the community of the Parsi faith and learn about their beliefs regarding the circle of life before heading to a little bit of heaven on earth, the coastal paradise of Goa. This hot spot for "in the know" travelers feature white, sandy beaches and is surrounded by tropical plant life. Bill introduces both the armchair and actual traveler to this incredible destination. We explore the Portuguese influence on Goa's architecture and cuisine, tour the ghost city of Old Goa and explore Roman Catholic churches.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Where can you find literally hundreds of Jain Temples, a lost civilization and one of the top birding destinations in the world—the Bhavnagar region of course. Follow Bill as he attempts to climb 4000 steps to the great Jain temples of Palitana, floats through a lagoon full of flamingoes, egrets and cranes and learns about a kingdom lost to history.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Nicknamed the Garden of Eden, this volcanic caldera is home to over 25,000 big game animals. Here survival isn't just a game—it's a matter of life and death. You'll witness one of the great acts of nature—buffalo, lion and hyena in a face-to-face struggle for dominance. Life in the crater can take surprising twists.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: One of the most modern cities in Africa, Cape Town has something for everyone. We explore the city's architecture, taste a little wine at nearby Vineyards and track down the only penguin species in Africa before reaching the fabled Cape of Good Hope…just a scenic drive outside the city proper.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The Latest in Martian exploration from orbit and on the ground, new sources of water and planetary dust storms are a few of the stories unfolding on to the Red Planet.

programme.title: New Frontier

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Take a trip to the Jersey Shore and learn how one of its famous boardwalks helped to inspire the iconic board game of Monopoly. And how did a donkey and an elephant become associated with politics? Plus, what's the difference between top grain leather and full grain leather?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!

We'll throw up the red flag and explain why the color is simply a cover up!

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Paper wasn't always easy to make or use. Early writing appeared on cave walls, bamboo, and papyrus. True paper was credited to Cai Lun in 105 AD. It was once expensive, but after the Black Death, cloth scraps made it cheaper. Pens evolved too—from messy feathers to the ballpoint. Today, paper contributes heavily to pollution—about 10% of greenhouse gases. The future? E-paper: the digital alternative to traditional paper.

programme.desc: Every single day there is a growing number of people to feed and in the next thirty to forty years we will need to double our food production to sustain the increase in population. In this episode author Julian Cribb examines the infestations that are threatening our food supply.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: Disasters in the air and misfortunes at sea grab our attention because of the unusually large number of fatalities involved. But it's not even necessary to leave dry land for a terrible disaster to happen. Rail journeys and even just getting in your car can be fraught with disaster. That's the focus for this instalment of Desperate Hours _ road and rail disasters. We will examine the causes of such accidents, be that the powers of nature or human folly. We are about to explore the worst of the worst destructive events from an ordinary day on Nigerian roads to a disastrous display of human error in Santiago de Compostella when the driver of a loaded passenger train went about 115 km/h over the established speed limit and drove his train straight into a wall. So buckle up; you're in for a bumpy ride…

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. From tending to oversexed otters, fine-footed flamingoes or armoured armadillos, a day spent with Jorge, is a day immersed in nature from the four corners of the globe. Ever seen a grown man hug a turtle? For Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, it's all part of the job! He's hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research _ but first he's just got to locate the turtle _ 2,000 meters down in the ocean!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: "Finding Nemo" may have brought fame to the striped clownfish but their newfound popularity has sent worldwide numbers into decline. Now we follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more Nemos to come. Jorge has got a 200-pound problem on his hands. Lin Mao the white tiger has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis. Problem is, Lin Mao's not responding to the anesthetic Jorge just administered and he has to decide what to do next...very quickly.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The explosive sprinting Cheetah. The mighty bounding kangaroo. The horned and leaping wildebeest. The powerful and sure footed horse. Or the quick footed pronghorn. Which is the fastest over land? Cheetah _ On Africa's savannahs, predator and prey race at breathtaking speeds. Pronghorn _ North America's fastest, it sustains 60 km/h and can reach nearly 100. Wildebeest _ Iconic endurance runners; calves walk within minutes and run within days. Kangaroo _ Australia's largest marsupial, alert and powerful, built for speed. Brumby _ Wild horses, symbols of strength and freedom, gallop unbridled across Australia.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Fanged Spiders with their scurrying bites. The Scorpion with its deadly sting... A sinister cold bloodied crocodile. The hypnotizing venomous snake. Or the King of Beasts, the Lion? Which one is the most dangerous? Lion _ With golden fur and regal mane, the lion reigns as the 'King of Beasts'. Scorpions _ In scorched deserts, danger awakens after sunset. Spiders _ Masters of webs and venom, spiders haunt myth and imagination. Snakes _ Feared and revered, snakes symbolize power, death, and rebirth. Crocodile _ Ancient and deadly, crocodiles inspire fear and legend across the globe.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Believe it or not, many scuba divers want to see great whites up close, and photographers want dramatic shots. But how do you get the sharks to where you want them? For decades, it's been done by baiting, or "chumming" _ attracting sharks with food. This practice is being questioned and banned in many countries because of a dramatic increase in shark attacks.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Crocodiles, descended from reptiles 250 million years ago, lurk just beneath the waterline, striking fear into prey. Turtles, among the oldest reptiles, use their shells for protection and camouflage across land, freshwater, and sea. Snakes, from rattlesnakes to dwarf pipe snakes, share traits like legless bodies and lidless eyes, relying on sun for warmth. The king cobra's venom can kill an elephant. Lizards escape predators by shedding tails, which regrow differently. For reptiles, cold blood offers a survival edge in the Race of Life.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Predators use speed, teeth, poison, and trickery to survive, but prey animals have evolved fascinating defenses. While fleeing is common, others use deception and chemistry—camouflage, mimicry, and toxins. Insects mimic leaves, snakes play dead, fish fly, and toads have poisonous skin. Predator-prey dynamics form an evolutionary arms race, with each side adapting to outsmart the other. Defense mechanisms include claws, poison, camouflage, and foul sprays. From zebra patterns to spider silk, strong defenses are vital to winning the Race of Life.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In this epic octopus adventure, Jonathan visits two aquaria to learn about the Giant Pacific octopus, and then travels to Seattle, Washington (USA) to join the Seattle Aquarium dive team on an octopus survey. He meets the Giant Pacific Octopus, the world's largest octopus, and discovers how clever this huge invertebrate really is!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan joins shark researcher Dr. Stephen Kajiura to test how well wild sharks can detect electrical fields in their environment. Then, he heads to New Jersey (USA) to learn how to dive in the Mark V commercial diving helmet! Finally, he ends up in the Gulf of Mexico to learn how oil platforms can actually become a healthy artificial reef and attract marine life from miles around.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Rubber was first used by South American tribes for waterproofing and bouncing balls. Westerners struggled with melting rubber until Charles Goodyear discovered vulcanization, making rubber durable. This sparked the rubber boom, enriching cities like Manaus. Britain broke Brazil's monopoly by smuggling seeds. Later, synthetic rubber and Kevlar were developed—Kevlar is so tough it can stop bullets. Rubber's journey is full of quirky discoveries.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Canned food began with Napoleon's contest to preserve food, won by Appert's boiled, sealed bottles. The British later developed metal cans, though early ones exploded or caused illness. Can openers came 30 years later. Pasteur's germ theory explained spoilage. Pressure-cooking improved taste, and now, 'raddaperization'—zapping food—is the future. Canning evolved from battlefield necessity to high-tech preservation.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's one of the world's most famous train stations _ Grand Central Terminal. We'll take you on a trip to reveal its many fascinating secrets! And if they are cleaned without water, how do clothes get spotless when they are dry cleaned?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's cheesy and and eaten all over the world! You'll learn how Dominick's pizza became Domino's pizza. And we all know how going to a circus wouldn't be complete without fluffy sweet cotton candy! We'll explain how this feathery goodness Spun to life! And all the spy action heroes use them, but where did the term gadget really come from?

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The question often rises is the cost of space exploration really worth it? Could the money be better spent elsewhere. If so one space program would have to remain. The planetary defence program, to locate identify and deflect a wayward asteroid from hitting Earth and destroying our civilzation because at last count there were 15,000 possible dangerous candidates close to Earth.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: For an instrument first developed as recently as the 17th century, the telescope has travelled a long way. The latest version of the once-humble telescope will be going a lot farther _ carrying us ever closer to the first light that ever bathed the Universe in which we live.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: The Body Transfer Illusion tricks the brain into feeling ownership of a fake body part, like in the rubber hand experiment. The Autokinetic Effect makes stationary lights seem to move in darkness. The Moon Illusion causes the moon to appear larger near the horizon due to visual references. Geometric illusions distort shapes and lines through clever design. Stereoscopy lets us perceive depth by merging two flat images into one 3D view.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Animation creates motion from still images shown in rapid sequence. Aviation illusions affect pilots' balance due to conflicting sensory input. The spinning dancer illusion shows bistable perception—viewers may see it spin in either direction. Mirages occur when light bends through layers of air at different temperatures. Rainbows form when sunlight refracts and reflects through water droplets, splitting light into visible colors.
